purpose: Measure Whisper's documented fabrication over non-vocal audio (Careless Whisper, FAccT 2024) on Vietnamese speech with published reference transcripts.
insertion_rule: longest internal pause per clip (silencedetect, peak-22 dB, >= 0.2 s), grown by [4.0, 5.0, 6.0] s of digital silence at the pause midpoint
